rules.statement: In a case where a lease precedes a mortgage and the lease stipulates that any subsequent mortgage should terminate the lease, it is necessary to join the lessee as a party defendant in the mortgage suit.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where a property has been leased to one party and then mortgaged to another, end the mortgagee desires to realize his mortgage, it is necessary to join the lessee as a party defendant in the mortgage suit, even though the lease stipulated for its determination upon the passing of a mortgage decree."
